hypothesis: About half of HB2+GP's remaining squared error in a held-out condition series is a shape error shared by all conditions of that series. An extractant-level hierarchy (series shape effect + small condition deviation) that pools each condition's own k-shot reads across the series predicts the adjacent log SF better than the same model on one cell's reads and better than a pooled ridge line given identical reads.
contract: SETTING P (pooled series), a different regime from attempts 1-2. For a held-out cell: its own k+1 reads (gen20 DOPT_Q, label-free) AND, for every other held-out cell of the same extractant in the same publication (other conditions of the series), that cell's own k+1 reads at the same budget k (capped at its k_max); only within-cell read differences are used. No unread metal of any cell is used. Assumes the new extractant is measured as a condition series with k+1 metals read in every condition: the extractant-level budget is sum over its cells of (k+1). Singleton cells get the own-reads prediction. Attempt 3 reads by SERIES_STAGGER (label-free; each condition of a series prefers metals the series has not read yet; = gen20 UNIFORM for the first cell and for singletons); attempt 3d is the control with gen20's DOPT_Q reads (identical read sets across a series). Model parameters: weighted ML on the outer training groups (extractant x publication) only. Rows whose pair has both ends read in some sibling cell are flagged (sib_pair_read) and scored separately.
